scope: Stable full-view names for four retained toggle findings and the full Turntable Play/Pause Dock. A separate shared-Dock inventory identifies further work. This does not establish complete catalog accessibility or final performance/motion acceptance.

names.scope: Initial and deliberate reduced-motion full-view states of 29 retained label/name findings, plus focused normal-motion Flip Grid/Orbit and four stable-toggle stories, in both Stage themes and desktop/compact widths. Compares explicitly reviewed primary labels with actual Chrome accessibility names, retaining original raw axe findings separately. Symbolic fields receive descriptive-name checks. This does not establish speech-recognition behavior, all intermediate motion frames, all catalog accessibility or native thumbnail acceptance. Audio output is disabled in these naming contexts; synthesis is covered separately.
names.behaviors: The four toggles retain their actual browser names across Enter, state changes, queued held Enter and return. Original pressed states change and return; current descriptions retain the complete visible pass face. Turntable Dock retains both visible Play/Pause aliases.

repeatability.scope: 1440px dark normal-motion native Glass Pass, two independent mounts per source and six captures per mount. Each mount remains exact. Both sources produce the same two complete PNG outcomes. This diagnoses cross-context raster variation; it does not certify a universal pixel bound or default-GPU timing.

native.scope: Independent original/current paused native definitions. Exact geometry, DOM and computed styles. Non-Glass PNG bytes are required exact after priming; Glass pixels are reported without a cross-context equality claim because same-source mounts exhibit two raster outcomes. The separate repeatability experiment retains both outcomes for both sources. GPU disabled for CSS/pixel comparison only; not default-GPU or timing acceptance.

sharedDockInventory.scope: Full-view shared Dock controls in components declaring aria-pressed, at 1440px dark/reduced motion. Samples initial visible enabled toggles, then actual Enter input and a settled 350ms observation. Captures actual Chrome AX names before/after, retaining every drift for review. Does not cover controls appearing only in later states, all timing endpoints, thumbnail semantics, speech recognition, audio output or complete accessibility. Audio is disabled in these contexts.
